asr_text: Beans cost less now. When you hear that, your wallet pumps its fist. You already imagine your usual cup costing less, too. But a shop's price may not change right away. When a price tag makes you ask, haven't you heard the news? It feels like there is a delay. The International Coffee Organization shared a measure of coffee prices. It fell 8.7% from the month before. The group said more beans picked in Brazil had reached the market. It also expected a good supply to continue. The U.S. Department of Agriculture said several things had raised prices at once. There was bad weather in Brazil and Vietnam. Fewer beans were for sale. Demand was also strong.
